candidates.title: KunServe: Elastic and Efficient Large Language Model Serving with Parameter-centric Memory Management
candidates.reason: KunServe frees GPU memory under burst load by selectively dropping replicated model parameters and using remote attention/cooperative execution, directly updating hierarchical-memory, KV-cache pressure, and serving-system lineages.

candidates.title: LLM-PQ: Serving LLM on Heterogeneous Clusters with Phase-Aware Partition and Adaptive Quantization
candidates.reason: LLM-PQ jointly optimizes mixed-precision quantization, phase-aware partitioning, and micro-batch sizing for heterogeneous GPU serving, directly extending heterogeneous serving and quantized inference-system lineages.

candidates.title: Characterizing Power Management Opportunities for LLMs in the Cloud
candidates.reason: ASPLOS 2024 characterizes LLM inference power behavior and introduces power-oversubscription mechanisms for serving clouds, adding a systems-relevant resource-management dimension to deployment and scheduling coverage.

candidates.title: MegaScale-MoE: Large-Scale Communication-Efficient Training of Mixture-of-Experts Models in Production
candidates.reason: Production MoE training system combines communication-efficient parallelism, computation/communication overlap, and communication compression at 1,440-GPU scale, directly extending distributed heterogeneous MoE training coverage.
